Do we really need this header? See if adding it in source file only is sufficient.

All headers in the .hpp are used directly in the class definition:

- <array>: std::array (line 47)
- <cstdint>: uint8_t (line 39)
- <memory>: std::shared_ptr, enable_shared_from_this (line 22, 41-53)
- <span>: std::span<const uint8_t> in processResponse declaration (line 37)
- <string>: std::string (line 40, 49)
- <system_error>: std::error_code in processResponse declaration (line 36)

<span> and <system_error> cannot be moved to .cpp because processResponse is a private member function declared in the class definition — the parameter types must be complete at the declaration site.
Where is this function being used?

Done. Removed — it was unused.
